title: Integral type Gauss-Green formula on non-collapsed RCD spaces and its applications
summary: We prove an integral type Gauss-Green formula on non-collapsed RCD spaces using the strong locality of the Laplacian and an eigenfunction approximation method. As applications, we generalize Colding's monotonicity formulas and prove an asymptotic formula linking the mean curvature of a hypersurface at a given point to the volume of small balls centered at that point.
